input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products in production; merge when done.
task: Deepen (flagship 5) einvoice-preflight: Extended-CTC-FR and Factur-X EXTENDED base sets on the plain route

doc_friction.issue: Named chant-forge, whose remaining items need a singer or are fine OMR tweaks; two earlier sessions in two days also left it. Its row still has neither buildable: nor inputs_only:.

deviations.why: allocate picked row 7 chant-forge (its open items are OMR tweaks or need a singer); the routine asks for revenue-generating products, and einvoice-preflight (row 3, no PR in the last 24 h, France's reform live since 1 Sept 2026) had a buildable item that removes false rejections of real invoices
deviations.did: took einvoice-preflight's open item 'Extended-CTC-FR base sets'
deviations.result: landed: 15/15 FNFE extended examples go from failing to passing; 175/175 runs match Saxon; 13/13 real ZUGFeRD corpus files match Saxon

goal: Fewer false rejections for French and German senders of extended e-invoices
notes: Before: the EN 16931 base raised 4-16 findings (fatal BR-CO-10, BR-22, BR-26 ...) on each of FNFE's 15 extended examples. After: FNFE's EXTENDED-CTC-FR base (UBL 953, CII 773 checks) and Factur-X 1.09.2 EXTENDED (1,464 checks; its 210 document() code-list lookups inlined at build time, which otherwise skipped 30-40 checks per invoice) replace the base for those BT-24 ids. Cross-check vs Saxon-JS on FNFE's compiled XSLT: 175/175 runs, 43 ids, 0 skipped. Real files: 13 extended XMLs from ZUGFeRD/corpus 84f8d8f (PDF attachments via pdfdetach): false fatal BR-CO-12/BR-S-08 removed on 4; remaining findings are code-list drift (9958 -> 0204) the EU base also raised; plain = Saxon 13/13. Local: run_venture_tests einvoice-preflight 2602 tests ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes DONE exit 0 (all run: steps passed; uses: steps, cross-review bots and deploy jobs not run locally). The existing BR-FR/CDAR/EU sets rebuilt byte-identical.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: compile three Schematron sets, inline code lists, write a Saxon cross-check and a real-file run, tests and docs: about a day and a half for an engineer who knows Schematron

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
